description: Intervene in a running task on the user's behalf: pause, resume, stop, or steer with a plain-text instruction the next step must honour (for example 'skip site 3'). Requires the hands:control scope (request it at OAuth consent or agent signup, or create an API key with it) and works only on tasks this key or OAuth grant started; an agent cannot lift a pause the user set, and takeover and the kill switch are available only from the user's own dashboard session.

instruction.description: Required for steer: the user's instruction

name: alterlab_task_control
title: Control Browser Task
